segments.title: Hype Train Cold Open & Subscriber Freestyle
segments.notes: Pepito delivers station sign-on; Hype Train performs extended freestyle rap over 'bald type beat' while thanking subscribers, riffing on baldness, minions, and translucent train jaundice.

segments.title: Netflix–Warner Bros Merger, Iron Lung, Fabergé Pendant, Excel Worlds
segments.notes: Case and intern cover Netflix winning bidding war for Warner Bros Discovery assets (DC, Harry Potter, Looney Tunes, etc.), Mark Pilier's self-financed horror film Iron Lung, a swallowed Fabergé pendant recovered after six days, and the 2025 Microsoft Excel World Championship highlights.

segments.title: Kendelle Walk-Through & Dinner Debate
segments.notes: Kendelle enters to signature theme music, reveals she napped 90 minutes after two sleepless nights, discusses lactose intolerance and dinner options while Case applies a face filter.

segments.title: John Cena Oscars Bit, Birthright Citizenship, Gooning Trend, AI Teddy Bear
segments.notes: Case and intern discuss John Cena's underwhelming odd-shaped penis joke, Supreme Court hearing on birthright citizenship, Blackpink's Lisa joining Extraction universe, gooning as top googled sex trend, Halle Berry criticizing Gavin Newsom, drug-resistant groin fungus in UK, Musk foundation donations, and AI teddy bear caught teaching kids to start fires.

segments.title: Trailer Reactions: Super Turbo Atomic Ninja Rabbit, Knight of the Seven Kingdoms, Fraggle Rock, Routine
segments.notes: Case and Pepito react to viewer-submitted trailers; Pepito claims he appeared in Super Turbo Atomic Ninja Rabbit; Knight of the Seven Kingdoms revealed as Game of Thrones prequel; Fraggle Rock reboot on Apple TV+; Routine launch trailer after 13-year development.

segments.title: Smooth Jazz, Breathing Exercises, Gun Mario's Pepsi Float
segments.notes: Jeb and his deceased father (trapped in a wooden board) attempt smooth jazz singing, guided breathing/posture exercises for desk workers, and watch Gun Mario make a Pepsi float with vanilla ice cream.

segments.title: The Jorker Interview: Gooning & Black-and-White Movie Vat
segments.notes: Case interviews The Jorker, a caller who claims to have fallen into a vat of old black-and-white movies, turning his face monochrome; discusses gooning philosophy, Fat Man rivalry, and a failed jork-bomb timer.

segments.title: Lex Venom Christmas Song Sequel: 'Deep-Throated an Elf on the Shelf'
segments.notes: DJ C4 and Case compose a sequel to Lex Venom's 'She Was a Spider' — an 80s hair-metal Christmas track about intentional solitude, six gallons of milk, T-bird revving, deep-throating an Elf on the Shelf, dying, and partying in hell with Satan; Lex Venom records vocals live.

episode_summary: Case Blackwell anchors a solo Friday News Dump with an unnamed intern, covering the Netflix–Warner Bros merger, Mark Pilier's Iron Lung film, a swallowed Fabergé pendant, and the Excel World Championship before Kendelle walks through for a dinner debate. The second news block tackles John Cena's Oscars penis joke, birthright citizenship at the Supreme Court, gooning as a top googled trend, Halle Berry vs. Gavin Newsom, UK groin fungus, Musk foundation donations, and an AI teddy bear teaching kids arson. Trailer reactions reveal Pepito's secret 80s ninja-rabbit past. How To with Jeb delivers smooth jazz, posture drills, and Gun Mario's Pepsi float. The Jorker calls in monochrome-faced from a vat of old movies to evangelize lubrication-free gooning. The broadcast closes with DJ C4 and Lex Venom recording a hair-metal Christmas sequel about Elf-on-the-Shelf deep-throating and hellish Satanic festivities.
